name: 01_default_window
description: [Part of the 15_16_orders_changes_chain chained test] Change feed on a first run: no previous state, so the component must synthesise the default 7-day `from` window itself. `from` is otherwise a mandatory query parameter the mock rejects with 400 when absent. Scaffolded with --output tests/functional/15_16_orders_changes_chain and --chain-state so this test's real out/state.json is threaded live into the next test's in/state.json by the datadirtest chaining mechanism (see DataDirTester._is_chained_test / TestChainedDatadirTest) — a standalone (non-chained) test's in/state.json is always reset to {} in setUp, so a committed static seed alone cannot prove watermark arithmetic through a full record+replay cycle.

name: 02_incremental_watermark
description: [Part of the 15_16_orders_changes_chain chained test] Change feed on a second run, chained from 01_default_window's real out/state.json. Proves the watermark minus lookback_hours (5h) reaches the `from` query string instead of the default window.
